dict.Al doilea câmp pe coloane: fiecare coloa: Second column field: each column of the first field is split by the values of this column, with a subtotal column for each group
dict.O coloană „… Total” după fiecare grup al: A "… Total" column after each group of the first column field
dict.Mai multe valori merg doar cu cel mult u: More values work only with at most one column field and with values shown as numbers
dict.Câmpurile calculate merg doar cu cel mul: Calculated fields work only with at most one column field and with values shown as numbers
